statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: X compact connected Riemann surface, P finite, H_i meromorphic with poles only in P, g_i = -eta Im H_i, L a real linear combination of the g_i, D a component of {g_i > 0 for all i, L < 0} in X \ P. If (1) at boundary points of D in X \ P with all g_i >= 0 and some g_i = 0 we have L >= 0, (2) -L <= M d on D with d >= 0 bounded near each p in P, and (3) not all H_i are constant, then D is empty.
